_doc: PREVIEW / TEST ONLY — never the live table. Mert's online price list (23 Nov 2026, OPERATING_MODEL §9; assumptions to be confirmed by Mert, K-046). Per-product ONLINE single price by group (not the till price): A £5, B £8, C £13. At 10+ units in the cart (ALL groups counted together) EVERY unit costs its group's 10+ price: A £1.50, B £2.40, C £3.90. 1–9 units pay the single price, no intermediate steps (non-monotonic by design: 9 × £8 = £72, 10 × £2.40 = £24). Delivery £1.49, free with 10+ units (no spend threshold). Groups: A Stretch Bracelet; B Gradient Edit + Stretch Charm Bracelet + Hair Clips (last-arrived 18 barcodes) + Necklace Lux; C Diamond Bracelet + Hair Claws + Necklace Lux Stone + Stretch Double Bracelet + Bangle. family_groups maps only the DB families (karmi_online_caps.family) that sit wholly in one group; 'hair' (Clips B + Claws C) and the families not online yet (Stretch Bracelet, Necklace Lux, Bangle) need a per-product group (proposed DB column karmi_online_products.online_group). Selectable only with ?ladder=M1_mert_list on a Vercel PREVIEW (VERCEL_ENV=preview) or KL_LADDER_PREVIEW=1.

B.label: Gradient Edit, Stretch Charm, Hair Clips, Necklace Lux
